text: I think people like it because they want to see new things. Every country has different food, music and buildings, so travelling is interesting. Also, people can learn about other cultures and meet new friends. For example, my cousin visited Korea and he learned a lot about the language. Some people go abroad only to rest, because their daily life is busy. So I think travelling is good for everyone.

tips.en: Start with I think and give a reason at once.
tips.kk: I think-тен бастап, себепті бірден беріңіз.
tips.ru: Начинайте с I think и сразу давайте причину.
tips.example: I think people like it because they want to see new things

tips.en: A short real example brings the answer to life.
tips.ru: Короткий пример из жизни делает ответ живым.
tips.example: For example, my cousin visited Korea

questions.followUp: Do you think travel is expensive?
questions.question: Why do people like visiting other countries?

text: I prefer travelling with other people, especially my family or friends. When you travel with someone, you can share the cost and help each other. It is also safer, because you don't feel alone in a new place. Of course, travelling alone is more free, because you can do what you want. But for me, it is more fun to have someone to talk to and take photos with.

tips.en: Answer the question first, then give reasons.
tips.ru: Сначала ответ на вопрос, потом причины.
tips.example: I prefer travelling with other people

tips.en: Of course admits an advantage of the other option.
tips.kk: Of course екінші нұсқаның артықшылығын мойындайды.
tips.ru: Of course признаёт плюс другого варианта.
tips.example: Of course, travelling alone is more free

questions.question: Do you prefer travelling alone or with other people?

text: I think tourism is good because it brings money to a city. Tourists buy food and gifts, and they stay in hotels, so many people can find jobs. But there are some bad things, too. Popular places can be very crowded and noisy, and prices become higher. Also, some tourists leave rubbish in the streets. So a city must keep the places clean and control the number of people.

tips.en: So shows the result of a fact.
tips.example: Tourists buy food and gifts, and they stay in hotels, so many people can find jobs

tips.en: But clearly moves from pros to cons.
tips.ru: But чётко переводит от плюсов к минусам.
tips.example: But there are some bad things, too

questions.followUp: Does your city have many tourists?
questions.question: What are the good and bad things about tourism for a city?

text: I think holidays will be more modern. People will book everything on the phone, and maybe they will use robots in hotels. Also, travelling may be faster, so people can visit far countries in a few hours. Maybe some people will take holidays in space, but I think this will be very expensive. I hope people will still enjoy nature and simple trips, because they are good for health.

tips.en: Maybe and will help you talk about the future.
tips.kk: Maybe және will болашақ туралы айтуға көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Maybe и will помогают говорить о будущем.
tips.example: Maybe some people will take holidays in space

tips.en: I hope ends the answer on a positive note.
tips.example: I hope people will still enjoy nature
